Hi Tom + Lisa —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to hear about Acme's search & product-recommendation goals and the latency/cost targets you're working toward. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC: 

- Goal: validate Redwood inference for product recommendations (50 QPS burst, 300 token avg) with integrated prefix caching to lower per-token cost.
- Success criteria: <10% regression vs current quality, end-to-end latency <120ms p95 for ranked responses, and a cost estimate within the committed budget.

What we need to get the POC running:
- AWS account/role or service account for your infra team (we can also run in our sandbox if preferred during initial tests)
- Sample query set + expected ranking labels (10-20 examples to start)
- A target date for a 2-week POC window (we recommend 10 business days of active tests)

I attached a short POC runbook that outlines checklist items and a pricing quote for the trial. Proposed kickoff: Tue 2026-11-23 or Wed 2026-11-24 — 30-45 min to walk through the runbook and confirm access. Does either time work?

If priorities changed, totally fine — let me know and we can adjust the scope/timing. 

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

1) Quick troubleshooting session (15-30 min) where we walk your infra engineer through creating the role and running the first sample requests — I can run it with them step-by-step.
2) We run the POC in our sandbox using a semi-blind dataset and provide results; you can swap to your account later if needed.
3) If timelines shifted, we can pause this POC and reconnect in 4-6 weeks — I'll keep the quote and runbook active.

If you're open, I can book a troubleshooting slot as early as Mon 11/23 09:00 PST or Tue 11/24 13:00 PST. If those don't work, propose a time and I'll coordinate.
